rationale: EO 12576 (Dec. 2, 1986) delegated to the Secretary of State the President's functions under section 803 of the Act (5 U.S.C. 5569) and to the Secretary of Defense those under section 806 (37 U.S.C. 559), each for paying compensation to individuals held in captive status commencing on or before January 21, 1981, and directed the two Secretaries to consult (Secs. 1-3). EO 12598 (signed June 17, 1987; 52 FR 23421, Monday, June 22, 1987), issued to implement the same Title VIII of Public Law 99-399, restates the delegations of section 803(a) functions (5 U.S.C. 5569) to the Secretary of State (Sec. 1) and of section 806(a) functions (37 U.S.C. 559) to the Secretary of Defense (Sec. 3), repeats the consultation duty (Sec. 5) and states "Executive Order No. 12576 of December 2,1986, is hereby superseded." (Sec. 6). The delegations are therefore replaced, not merely ended: express supersession is the first end of all three clauses on 1987-06-17 (EO 12598 has no separate effective-date clause, so it operates from its signing date; the Federal Register publication date, June 22, 1987, is not the effective date). The order has no term of its own and no earlier end was found in the held sources; the OFR catalog records Superseded by EO 12598, June 17, 1987.
